# Security policy

Report a security problem in Studio privately through this repository's
[Security tab](https://github.com/amywork777/studio/security/advisories/new), not in a public
issue. Problems in T3 Code itself go to [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/security),
and problems in the CAD tools to [text-to-cad](https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad).
